payload.description:
Outcome: Chatticus has three named AWS environments from day one: development, staging, and production. Acceptance tests always target a named environment, never a nameless stack.

Promotion: merge to develop deploys or updates development. Promote to main updates staging. Production is an explicit gated deploy of a staging-proven release. Snapshots and computers stay shared account stacks and must not be destroyed.

Not included: custom domains, Amplify hosting, or putting computers on the turn path.
payload.title: Development, staging, and production cloud environments
